items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I replaced with Jeanette when, after Jeanette got married and she was about to have her first child.

ctx.x: Ray tuba player. He used to play, uh, Tuxedo Brass Band. And, uh, I worked with him a while. Then I played lots of funerals and parades with them, playing the drums, too. So, after them, I went with Papa Celestan. As was, uh, I replaced with Jeanette when, after Jeanette got married and she was about to have her first child. And I just remained with the band until it broke up. And also played with Ridley Tuxedo and the Creole Serenators. I worked with them a long time. That's where I learned to play the vibes.…
Who else was in that band beside Peter?
